protocol.rule: each attempt is written from the champion's training misses; the attempt with the most training cases localized, if more than the champion, is scored on the selection cases and replaces the champion when gained - lost >= margin and the one-sided exact sign test <= alpha; validation cases are scored once by verify after the lineage is frozen

role_rule: sha256('genesis-localizer-lineage-v1|' + case) mod 10: 0-2 training, 3-6 selection, 7-9 validation
